text:
jess: quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 to apply a tiny proto rename and accompanying generated go changes. It needs one more approver to merge in today's window. @morgan @oliver any chance for a quick look?

morgan: on it, grabbing a coffee then i'll skim

sai: small question — the proto field currently `client_id` -> is the plan to rename to `clientId` (camelCase)? will that change JSON payloads?
jess: it's internal proto used only by runtime shims; JSON tag is kept stable so payloads won't break. the rename is to make generated Go identifiers consistent. I did adjust the json tag in the proto so it's backwards-compatible.

jess: also hitting a `gofumpt` failure on the generated file; it's noise from formatting generated code. I noted an exemption in the PR description. snippet:```diff
- message Request { string client_id = 1; }
+ message Request { string clientId = 1; }
```

ci-bot: buildkite: PR-4821 — tests failed (gofumpt) — https://ci.example.com/builds/12345

morgan: OK. my plan: review for API safety, if json tag is stable i'm fine. for gofumpt, can we add a linter exception for `proto/gen/` path?

oliver: i can add the linter allowlist if we decide that's the route. otherwise i'm fine merging once CI is green and there's one more LGTM. i can merge during the 15:00 PT merge window.

jess: thanks — i pushed a tiny follow-up commit that applies `gofumpt -w` to the generated file and force-pushed. that should clear the linter once CI reruns.

sai: quick review done, left one tiny test-name nit in the PR, nothing blocking — i'll approve after that is fixed.
morgan: LGTM
sai: LGTM (test name tweak applied)

ci-bot: buildkite: PR-4821 — all checks passed ✅ — https://ci.example.com/builds/12346

oliver: merging in ~10m unless objections
jess: no objections, thanks all :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: merged PR #4821 by jess — commit 7a3f2b (thread 7067891234)
morgan: tiny follow-up: please add a short changelog entry in the next PR so the runtime release notes mention the compatibility note
jess: will do — opened follow-up PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4822 for changelog
